title: A Phase 3, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled, Multicenter Study of Nipocalimab in Adults with Moderate to Severe Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
official: A Phase 3, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled, Multicenter Study of Nipocalimab in Adults with Moderate to Severe Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the efficacy of nipocalimab compared with placebo on SLE disease activity
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Adult participants at the time of informed consent
2. Diagnoses of SLE and at least 1 positive autoantibody
3. SLEDAI-2K score
4. BILAG Score
Exclusion criteria:
1. Any condition for which, participation would not be in the best interest of the participant
2. Any clinically significant laboratory abnormality that is not considered appropriate or reasonable for the population under study.
3. Comorbidities requiring systemic GCs
4. Inflammatory diseases
5. Major surgical procedure prior to screening
